suggested_change: Criteria are appropriate but CLAUDE.md should clarify: (1) how to document explicit absence of evidence ('metrics don't exist' requires call confirmation, not inference); (2) competitive set validation rules (e.g., 'cross-reference candidate competitors against known platform categories'); (3) threshold for 'actionable'—next steps must name specific competitors/criteria, not open-ended questions; (4) ICP assumptions require explicit call evidence or flagged as assumption, not treated as fact.
